narrative_purpose: Put both columns of fire's nutrient ledger in one frame: what leaves as smoke, what stays as an alkaline ash bed on cleared ground, and the charcoal that persists in the soil for millennia.
subject: A cutaway of freshly burnt ground shown from the side, cut open like a section of earth. From TOP to BOTTOM: thin wisps of pale grey smoke drifting upward and off the top of the frame; a woody cone about the size of a fist, its scales split wide open, hanging on a charred branch stub with three winged seeds falling from it; a layer of pale chalky grey-white ash lying loosely across the ground surface; below that dark brown soil in which several small angular black charcoal fragments are embedded; and a few charred blackened stumps standing up through the ash layer.
scene: A burnt clearing at dusk, the cut face of the ground filling the lower two thirds of the frame, the sky above dim and hazed, no living vegetation anywhere.
camera: Level side-on cross-section view, as in a naturalist soil-profile plate, the layers reading clearly one above the other.
light: Dim overcast light from above; the pale ash layer is the brightest thing in the frame, catching cool light; a faint residual ember-orange warmth glows at the base of one stump. The soil and charcoal fall into deep shadow.
palette: Cool chalky grey-white ash and deep indigo-brown soil dominant, black charcoal fragments, one faint restrained ember-orange point at a stump base, pale grey smoke.
style: Painterly naturalist soil-profile plate, observed and diagrammatic in arrangement but painted throughout.
detail_level: High on the split cone, the falling seeds, the texture of the loose ash layer and the angular charcoal fragments in the soil; the sky and background soft.
composition: Clear horizontal banding from smoke at the top through the cone, the ash layer and the soil below, with the cone on the left and a broad area of plain dim sky at the upper right kept clear framed by deep negative space.
consistency_notes: Three things must be legible at once: smoke leaving upward, a pale ash layer resting ON TOP of intact dark soil, and black charcoal fragments embedded WITHIN that soil. The cone is split open with seeds falling. No flames beyond a faint ember glow, and no green plants anywhere.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no arrows or leader lines, no chemical symbols or diagram keys, no green foliage, no large flames, no 3D-render or photographic look, no cartoon style
